Price jump

Free to £297 in one step

A woman who downloads your guide and likes what she reads has two choices: wait, or commit £297 or more. Most will wait, and you never find out which of them were close.

One start date

Demand that arrives between rounds

The Nourished Cycle has one start date (February). Anyone ready in October has a waitlist, not a next step, and their interest cools while they wait.

Reach

Reach tied to posting

Your last 7 reels drew 1.7k to 6.8k views each. That’s a real, engaged audience, but without ads every new client still depends on the next post landing.

The women who’d be perfect for The Nourished Cycle and your 1:1 work are already reading your free guide. There’s no paid first step yet that lets them learn from you live and raise their hand.

My recommendation

A £17 live masterclass, “Nourish Your Cycle”, that finds your next 1:1 clients

You don’t have low-ticket products yet, so the class itself should be paid. A £17 seat earns from the first sale and pays for the ads, a kitchen kit on the thank-you page adds to it, and an application on the replay page sends serious women to a discovery call.

Meet Kate

Hi, I’m Kate Booker

I’m a naturopathic nutritional therapist specialising in women’s hormone health. I trained for three years at the College of Naturopathic Medicine, I’m a Nutrigenomics Practitioner with LifecodeGX, and I teach on the NatLife Coach course.

I help women understand what their body is communicating, and build food and lifestyle habits that support their hormones. This class is the clearest hour I can give you on where to start.
